records.text: Because the Bears game ended at 8:30 p.m., Frank Turek was not walking with Charlie Kirk at 8 p.m. as Turek described.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: That game ended at 830. So he definitely was not walking with Charlie (Charlie Kirk) eight o'clock

verification.notes: The official NFL gamebook shows the game began at 7:16 p.m. CDT (5:16 p.m. Arizona time), and the recorded 3:16 duration puts the finish around 8:32 p.m. Arizona time. But Turek said Kirk asked him to come back 'about eight' and described texts and a delay before the walk; he did not clearly claim they were already walking at exactly 8. The game timing is supported, while the contradiction alleged is overstated.
